description: This is a Python source file implementing the backend API for a Tic Tac Toe game using FastAPI. It defines API endpoints for health check, starting new games, retrieving game state, and submitting moves. It imports models, storage, and game engine logic, and sets up middleware and route handlers.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint that confirms the service is running.

methods.name: NewGameResponse create_game(payload: NewGameRequest | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a new Tic Tac Toe game, optionally specifying the starting player, and returns the initial game state.

methods.name: GameState get_game_state( game_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique ID of the game"), )
methods.description: Fetches the current state of a specific game by its ID.

methods.name: GameState make_move( game_id: str = Path(..., description="The unique ID of the game"), payload: MoveRequest | None = None, )
methods.description: Submits a move to the game, applying validation and returning the updated game state.
